prompt:
You receive 2 images. Image 1 is a finished background painting of our point-and-click adventure game: the rented meeting salon of Hotel Grand Jasna at Jasna, painted in summer 2035. Image 2 is the same painting with coloured boxes that only mark the interactive objects, the exits and the walkable floor, which must all stay exactly where they are. Edit image 1 into the SAME PLACE on 6 February 2035, a clear cold day in deep winter, seen by the SAME CAMERA: keep the exact viewpoint, lens, horizon, perspective and framing, and keep the position, size and outline of every building, wall, door, window, pole, rail, sign, piece of furniture, object and tree trunk. Change only what winter changes, as described below. Keep the painting technique, brushwork, palette handling and level of detail of image 1.

Inside the salon everything stays exactly as in image 1 (the curtains, the hotel chairs, Boris's table with the
archive boxes, the empty display board, the bookcase the box labelled 'Papierové knihy' in image 2 (x 1205-1420, y 360-700 of the 1920x1080 frame (63-74 % from the left, 33-65 % from the top)), the lectern with the open catalogue
the box labelled 'Záložka' in image 2 (x 1470-1615, y 545-630 of the 1920x1080 frame (77-84 % from the left, 50-58 % from the top)), the panelled door the box labelled 'exit: Pred hotelom Grand Jasná' in image 2 (x 1700-1880, y 400-705 of the 1920x1080 frame (89-98 % from the left, 37-65 % from the top)), the carpet). Winter shows only here:
- Through the big mullioned window at the left: the same view in deep winter - spruces loaded with snow, a white
  snow-covered mountain slope with a groomed ski piste and two or three tiny distant skiers, clear winter blue sky;
  frost flowers in the lower corners of the panes and a thin frost rim along the glazing bars.
- The wall screen shows the same mountain road video, now in winter: snowy hills, the road cleared between snow banks.
NPC zone at x 705-845, y 458-608 of the 1920x1080 frame (37-44 % from the left, 42-56 % from the top): an animated character sprite will be drawn here later, so paint no person, figure or silhouette in it. The character stands behind a table: paint the table's top edge as one straight horizontal line exactly at y 605 across x 675-875, with its front going down to the floor; above that edge keep only plain background (wall, shelves), no person. NPC zone at x 1115-1245, y 488-793 of the 1920x1080 frame (58-65 % from the left, 45-73 % from the top): an animated character sprite will be drawn here later, so paint no person, figure or silhouette in it. The character's feet stand on the floor at y 792.
Walkable floor: the band at x 0-1920, y 724-1015 of the 1920x1080 frame (0-100 % from the left, 67-94 % from the top) stays the same open carpet with nothing standing on it.

Fiction rules: no new lettering, no logos, no people except the tiny distant skiers, no animals.

Image 2 is a positioning aid only: do NOT draw any of its boxes, outlines, labels or captions. The result is image 1 edited, in the same 16:9 framing: no frames, no borders, no UI, no captions, no watermark, no text except the lettering already in image 1, and no people or animals unless stated above.

Lighting: a clear, cold, sunny winter day in the Low Tatras mountains: deep clean blue sky, low winter sun, crisp blue-violet shadows on the snow, sparkle on fresh snow, cold bright air. The brushwork, line quality and palette harmony stay exactly those of image 1 (style A).

Style: classic 1990s hand-painted adventure game background. Rich painterly brushwork, slightly exaggerated cartoon proportions with gently curved lines, warm late-afternoon sunlight, saturated but harmonious colours, soft dappled shadows under the trees.
